description: GXIVISION LSM22100 synchronized dual-lens USB stereo camera module, 4.2 mm / 54 degree lens version, with 1.5 m USB cable

ports.label: 5 V (barramento USB)
ports.src: input-voltage (5 V ±5%); power-consumption 0,91 W ÷ 5 V = 182 mA (calculado)
ports.note: alimentado pelo próprio cabo USB; a corrente é o quociente de dois valores de datasheet, não uma estimativa

specs.synchronization: both sensors capture the same frame at the same rate and resolution and are combined into a single side-by-side frame

lens.other-options: the same module is sold with 1.3, 2.4, 3 and 6 mm lenses, covering 180 to 54 degrees

specs.focus: fixed, object distance 5 cm to infinity
specs.auto-functions: AGC, AEC and white balance automatic; brightness, contrast, saturation, white balance, gamma, definition and exposure adjustable

input-voltage.note: DC 5 V +/- 5 percent, taken from the USB bus

communications.host-support: Windows, Linux (V4L2), macOS, Android (OTG); works with OpenCV and common webcam software
communications.note: appears to the host as a single UVC camera delivering a side-by-side frame; the left and right images must be split in software
